Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


If an ally could play Taste of Vitae as a vampire, then he would
get the effect as a vampire. There are no such allies.

There are a few allies that can play Soul Stealing "as a vampire",
however. They are treated as a vampire would be for that effect
when they play it "as a vampire".


